{{Quote|Where is 224?''"<br />"''Destroyed, supreme leader. The Jedi has overrun our position and...|This droid responding to Asajj Ventress.|<ref name="Ambush">{{TCW|Ambush}}</ref>}}
A '[[B1-series battle droid/Legends|''B1-Series battle droid''']] was stationed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Rugosa/Legends|Rugosa]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] and participated in the [[Battle of Rugosa/Legends|Battle of Rugosa]].

==History==
During the battle, this droid was part of a reinforcement squadron tasked with finding [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] along with three [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] and eliminating them before they reached their destination. As the droids advanced, they hit an impenetrable obstacle, a giant [[Tree/Legends|tree]] blocking the road, and a squadron was sent to continue on foot. This droid and another squad remained with the [[Armored Assault Tank/Legends|Armored Assault Tanks]], but they were later intercepted by Yoda and destroyed, while it was reporting to [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]].
